picks.file: Alexia de Lode - Prospekt af Odense.png
picks.what: View of the city, engraving in Den danske Atlas, vol. 3
picks.why: true general view across the fields; St Knud’s Cathedral and the town’s spires recognizable; plate border trimmed

picks.file: Sankt Knud cathedral side view Odense Denmark.jpg
picks.why: sharp color photo of the city’s main landmark

gaps: P0, P2: nothing; P4: only a stereo card of the railway station, a street stereo and a 1904 crowd at the town hall (royal visit), all weak; P5: the Odense Luftfoto aerials show village churches elsewhere in Denmark
notes: Engraving drawn before de Lode’s death in 1765, published 1767. #10 (town hall, 1904) could fill P4 as an event view if a reviewer accepts a crowd scene; #5 (Munkemølle, about 1844) is a pleasant painting but not a recognizable city view.
